label: Security & Trust
seo_description: Tenant isolation, governance audits, impersonation logging, and export controls — visibility-first security for education operations.
headline: Security and trust by design.
subheadline: Control plane audits, POST governance signals, scope consent, and evidence pages — not security theater.

segments.title: Tenant isolation
segments.body: School-scoped data paths with operator-run isolation audits and review queues.

segments.title: Governance visibility
segments.body: Generated security surface and POST-handler scans for mechanical review — operators stay in the loop.

segments.title: Support access
segments.body: Impersonation and support flows are logged and permissioned — no silent elevation.

segments.title: Exports & downloads
segments.body: Sensitive exports remain permission-checked; public anonymous report export is not a product path.
